name: Blind Mary
summary: In a ruined farmhouse southeast of Darkshire, Blind Mary wanders as a tormented banshee. Once a vain and beautiful woman, she was slain when the undead swept through Duskwood and rose in a form she could not bear.

sections.title: A Tragic Vanity
sections.body: Before the shadows fell across Duskwood, Mary was known for her beauty. She took great pride in it and rarely went without her treasured looking glass. When the undead swept through the region, Mary and many of her neighbors were slain. Her spirit found no rest in the earth. She became an ethereal banshee, condemned to wander the mortal realm in a ghastly, translucent form.

sections.title: Blinded by Despair
sections.body: Sorrow, horror, and fury overwhelmed Mary when she awoke among the undead. Unable to bear her monstrous reflection, she clawed out her own eyes with her bare hands. She cast away her beloved looking glass and drifted through her abandoned home, blind and weeping. Faint memories of the mortal life she lost were all she could cling to.

faq.answer: Blind Mary haunts a ruined homestead southeast of Darkshire as a banshee. She was a beautiful local woman, slain when Duskwood fell into darkness and raised as an undead spirit.

faq.q: Why is she called Blind Mary?
aliases: how did blind mary lose her eyes
faq.answer: Grief and despair at her banshee form made Mary unable to bear her reflection, so she clawed out her own eyes.
Blind Mary lingers in a dilapidated farmhouse called Blind Mary's Haunt, southeast of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood.

faq.q: Is Blind Mary hostile to living travelers?
aliases: can you talk to blind mary
faq.answer: Blind Mary does not attack travelers on sight. Unlike the aggressive ghouls and skeletons in the surrounding woods, she remains trapped in mourning. Those who approach her ruined home can speak to her.

faq.q: What happened to Mary's looking glass?
faq.answer: After tearing out her eyes in horror at her spectral form, Mary cast away her prized looking glass. It remains lost somewhere in Duskwood's haunted reaches.

faq.q: Why do adventurers seek out Blind Mary?
faq.answer: Travelers and local artisans visit Mary while carrying out work around Darkshire. Some seek her old looking glass for Viktori Prism'Antras's star-gazing device; others bring Madame Eva's spectral comb to gather ghost hair for special thread.

angles.text: As a tailor, you may seek spectral beings like Mary for ghost hair thread, a delicate material woven from ethereal remnants.
As a priest, you can see a soul left untethered by horrific trauma in Mary, caught between life and damnation through grief and vanity.
As an Alliance defender, you can see in Mary's fate how deeply Duskwood's curse has devastated its everyday townsfolk.
